opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) and local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) to help people with disability live more independently, focusing on training, employment, supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) and local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) to improve mental health services, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) and local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) to support care and services for older people, especially those with neurodegenerative conditions or isolation.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Conservation, restoration and interpretation of historic, architectural and cultural sites of outstanding significance, with public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital projects for new build, refurbishment or equipment to improve care in hospices and palliative care organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: New build, refurbishment and equipment to improve access to nationally significant collections in libraries and archives.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: New build, refurbishment and equipment to improve display and interpretation of nationally significant collections in museums and galleries.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital projects for new build, refurbishment or major equipment to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university. UK only.
opportunities.summary: New buildings, refurbishment and equipment to improve public engagement with science through the history of science, for organisations with scientific or natural history collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Universities and research institutions. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital projects for new buildings, refurbishment or major equipment to improve research infrastructure, including high‑quality research facilities and public engagement spaces.
